data.description:
## Context

Gerrit Verified retry run 31290743251 failed Ubuntu/Python 3.12 after 11,559 passing tests because tests/interfaces/store/test_git_contention_9305.py::test_concurrent_processes_through_seam_both_succeed observed writer beta return 1. The same lane and test passed on run 31289893832 against the identical patch set. The bridge change did not touch rebar._store.gitutil or this test.

## Plan

- Reproduce the concurrent add/commit seam failure repeatedly under xdist and capture the exact failed git command and stderr; the current subprocess assertion discards which inner command failed.
- Determine whether retry classification/exhaustion, shared-index semantics, or test nondeterminism violates the closed 9305 contention contract.
- Add a deterministic RED oracle at the real multi-process git seam, then fix the production contention policy or the test harness according to the proven cause.
- Validate repeated runs across supported Python versions without weakening the requirement that both writers succeed.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The failing inner git operation and cause are observable when the test fails.
- [ ] A deterministic regression test proves both concurrent writers succeed through run_git_write against one repository.
- [ ] Repeated xdist runs are stable on Python 3.11, 3.12, and 3.13.
- [ ] The fix preserves commit reachability and does not serialize unrelated repositories.
data.title: Flaky CI: git contention seam loses one concurrent writer
